name: css-pro
description: Stops agents wrecking your CSS. Checks CSS as it is written and refuses writes carrying provable defects — invalid values, declarations that silently do nothing, dead custom properties, accessibility failures. Raw CSS and CSS-in-JS; makes no style decisions for you.
